question: 'Hangul' (Kashmiri stag) is found in which Wildlife Sanctuary/National Park?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dachigam Sanctuary__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

 
• Dachigam National Park is located at a distance of 22 kilometers from Srinagar.
 
• It has **Hangul or Kashmir stag** which is a **critically endangered species.**
 
• **Since 1910 this park** has been declared as a** protected area**.
 
• It is spread in the area of **141 kilometre2 and declared as a national park in 1981**.
 
• This is the only area where **Kashmir stag is found.**
 
• Other species here include** Musk deer, Leopard, Leopard cat, a Himalayan black bear, Himalayan brown bear, Jungle cat,** and many others.
